title: 第7章 外傅大比第8章 训练
lines: 天老的道袍无风自动，袖中飞出七枚玉简，精准嵌入星图对应的天枢之位。
三百年前炎尊降世，也是这般北斗倒悬......
天老的指尖在颤抖，玉简表面浮现的裂纹与他龟甲上的裂痕如出一辙。
淬火池中的林烬忽然停止嬉闹，黑曜石般的瞳孔里跃动着两簇银火。
他张开嘴，发出清脆的童音：星星，甜。
悬浮的冰晶星图应声崩解，化作灵气旋涡涌入婴儿口中。
天老的道冠彻底炸成粉末，他踉跄着扶住青铜柱，
看到柱身上沉寂千年的铭文正顺着林烬的呼吸节奏明灭闪烁。
这不仅仅是引气入体......
地老手中的酒葫芦啪嗒落地，
这是......天地共鸣！
人老突然撕开上衣，露出布满火疤的胸膛。
他咬破指尖在胸口画出血符，玄铁砧轰然炸裂，九道赤红锁链破空而来。
管他什么共鸣！
先把这小怪物锁......
话音戛然而止。
林烬好奇地抓住一道锁链，银火顺着锁链蔓延，竟将人老胸口的血符烧成冰渣。
够了！
天老挥袖震开两人，虚空抓出一卷泛黄的古籍。
书页无风自动，停在绘有冰火太极的页面。
九狱炎骨本该至阳至烈，但极阴之魂逆转了阴阳。
他苍老的手指抚过书页上的注释，那些墨字突然活过来般扭曲重组，
最终凝成霜火同辉，破而后立八个血字。
淬火池突然沸腾，林烬周身浮现九层冰焰。
林烬赤足踏出水面，脚下绽放的冰莲竟将狱火冻结。
他歪着头看向呆立的三老，忽然伸手扯住天老的银发：
爷爷，冷。
这一声让天老浑身剧震。
他修道八百载的心境竟泛起涟漪，袖中准备捏诀的手怎么也抬不起来。
地老突然狂笑，捡起酒葫芦猛灌一口：
妙啊！
这小子把至阴至阳融会贯通，
方才引动的不是普通灵气，而是淬炼了千年的星辰精华！
人老却面色铁青，锻造锤重重砸向地面：
你们没发现吗？自从这小崽子开始引气，禁地的时空流速在加快！
他指向淬火池边的沙漏，本该十二时辰落尽的银沙，此刻竟已见底。
池水倒映的血月表面，冰壳正在以肉眼可见的速度增厚。
content_en:
Tianlao's Taoist robe automatically moved without wind, and seven jade slips flew out of the sleeves, accurately embedded in the Tianshu position corresponding to the star chart.
Three hundred years ago, Yan Zun came to the world, and the Big Dipper was hanging upside down...
Tianlao's fingertips were trembling, and the cracks on the surface of the jade slip were exactly the same as those on his tortoise shell.
Lin Jin in the quenching pool suddenly stopped playing, and two clusters of silver fire danced in his obsidian pupils.
He opened his mouth and uttered a clear childish voice: Stars, sweet.
The suspended ice crystal star map disintegrated and turned into a vortex of spiritual energy that poured into the baby's mouth.
Tianlao's Taoist crown was completely blown into powder. He staggered and held on to the bronze pillar.
He saw the inscriptions on the pillar that had been silent for thousands of years flickering in and out according to the rhythm of Lin Jin's breathing.
It’s not just about bringing gas into the body…
The wine gourd in the old man's hand clattered to the ground.
This is...the resonance of heaven and earth!
The old man suddenly tore open his shirt, revealing his chest covered with fire scars.
He bit his fingertips and drew a blood talisman on his chest. The black iron anvil exploded, and nine red chains shot through the air.
Never mind the resonance!
Lock up this little monster first...
The words stopped abruptly.
Lin Jin grabbed a chain curiously, and the silver fire spread along the chain, burning the blood talisman on the old man's chest into ice slag.
Enough!
Tianlao waved his sleeves and shook the two people away, then grabbed a yellowed ancient book from the void.
The pages of the book moved automatically without any wind, and stopped at the page with Ice and Fire Tai Chi.
The Nine Hell Flame Bones were supposed to be extremely yang and extremely strong, but the extremely yin soul reversed the yin and yang.
His old fingers stroked the annotations on the page, and the ink words suddenly came to life and twisted and reorganized.
In the end, it condensed into frost and fire, breaking and then standing up with eight blood characters.
The quenching pool suddenly boiled, and nine layers of ice flames appeared around Lin Jin.
Lin Jin stepped out of the water with his bare feet, and the ice lotus blooming under his feet actually froze the hellfire.
He tilted his head and looked at the stunned San Lao, and suddenly stretched out his hand to pull Tian Lao's silver hair:
Grandpa, it’s cold.
This sound made Tianlao tremble all over.
His state of mind, which had been practicing Taoism for eight hundred years, was actually rippled, and the hand in his sleeve ready to knead the secrets could not be raised.
The old man suddenly laughed wildly, picked up the wine gourd and took a swig:
Wonderful!
This guy has mastered the yin and yang,
What was aroused just now was not ordinary spiritual energy, but the essence of stars that had been tempered for thousands of years!
The old man's face was ashen, and the forging hammer hit the ground heavily:
Didn't you notice? Ever since this little brat started to draw energy, the flow of time and space in the forbidden area has been accelerating!
He pointed to the hourglass beside the quenching pool. The silver sand that should have fallen at twelve o'clock had actually bottomed out at this moment.
On the surface of the blood moon reflected in the pool water, the ice shell is thickening at a speed visible to the naked eye.
